title: Wushu, Teqball, and More: The 2026 Asian Games
text:
Toru Hanai / Getty

 Sorrasak Thaosiri and Jirati Chanliang of Thailand compete against Ahmad Kassem Arabi and Mohamad Hafez of Lebanon at the teqball men’s doubles final on day one of the 20th Asian Games at Nagoya City Higashiyama Sports Center on September 20, 2026, in Nagoya, Aichi, Japan.

 Long Lei / Xinhua / Getty

 Li Jianming of China competes during the Nanquan round of the men’s Nanquan and Nangun final of Wushu in Nagoya, on September 22, 2026.

 Andy Chua / Reuters

 Japan’s Kotomi Kato swims in the women’s 200-meter breaststroke final during the 2026 Asian Games at the Tokyo Aquatics Centre on September 24, 2026.

 Mark Baker / AP

 Malaysia’s Mandy Cebelle Chen competes in the women’s wushu taijijian final in Nagoya, on September 20, 2026.

 Anushree Fadnavis / Reuters

 Athletes take aim during the compound men’s individual 1/16 eliminations at Okazaki Central Park Multipurpose Square on September 28, 2026.

 Anushree Fadnavis / Reuters

 China’s Ziyu Zhang and teammates shake hands with Team Indonesia players after China won the women’s Group A basketball game on September 21, 2026.

 Naoya Azuma / The Yomiuri Shimbun / Reuters

 Thailand’s team competes in the artistic swimming mixed team free routine at Hamamatsu Swimming Center ToBiO in Hamamatsu City, on September 28, 2026.

 Andrew Couldridge / Reuters

 Japan’s Miwa Harimoto, alongside Hina Hayata, competes against China’s Man Kuai and Manyu Wang during the women’s doubles table tennis gold-medal match in Toyota, on September 28, 2026.

 Toru Hanai / Getty

 Jean Claude Saclag ( left ) of the Philippines and Daisuke Maruyama of Japan compete during the mixed martial arts men’s traditional -65 kilogram semifinals on day two of the 20th Asian Games at Nagoya City Inae Sports Center on September 21, 2026.

 Katsura Tanioka / Getty

 Pichet Pansan of Thailand scores a point while Muhammad Ubaidur Rohman of Malaysia attempts to block during the sepaktakraw men’s team Regu Group A match on day two of the 20th Asian Games on September 21, 2026.

 Chalinee Thirasupa / Reuters

 Japan’s Yuma Yamamoto looks dejected after finishing fourth in the women’s 5,000-meter final at Paloma Mizuho Sports Park on September 28, 2026.

 Mark Baker / AP

 China’s Yang Yang celebrates his lift during the men’s 60-kilogram weight-lifting final in Nagoya, on September 24, 2026.

 Aaron Favila / AP

 China’s Liu Xing competes in the men’s cycling BMX freestyle final in Nagoya, on September 27, 2026.

 Yong Teck Lim / Getty

 Kirin Petkiree of Thailand competes in the skateboarding men’s street final on day eight of the 2026 Asian Games.

 Lee Jin-man / AP

 Kazakhstan’s Yasmina Toxanbayeva splashes water on her face as she competes in the women’s marathon walk in Nagoya on September 27, 2026.

 Yong Teck Lim / Getty

 Marufa Akter of Bangladesh bowls during the cricket women’s bronze-medal match against Pakistan at Korogi Athletic Park on September 22, 2026, in Nisshin, Aichi.

 Jiji Press / AFP / Getty

 Japan’s Yuki Kurihara competes in the Puyo Puyo Champions final of the esports event at the 2026 Asian Games on September 26, 2026. Japan’s 11-year-old esports prodigy Yuki Kurihara won the gold medal, defeating a series of opponents up to three times his age.

 Mohd Rasfan / AFP / Getty

 China’s Yan Langyu competes in the final of the men’s trampoline gymnastics event at the Nagoya City General Gymnasium on September 27, 2026.

 Yuichi Masuda / Getty

 Djuraev Akbar of Uzbekistan competes in the snatch during the weight-lifting men’s 110-kilogram final on day 10 of the 2026 Asian Games.

 Toru Hanai / Getty

 Yuka Ueno of Japan celebrates winning the gold medal against South Korea in the fencing women’s foil team gold-medal match at Aichi Sky Expo on September 26, 2026.

 David Gray / AFP / Getty

 Indonesia’s Sumaya ( left ) plays a point against Myanmar’s Wai Khin Hnin during their women’s singles final teqball match in Nagoya on September 20, 2026.

 Katsura Tanioka / Getty

 Team Malaysia players celebrate winning the sepaktakraw men’s Team Regu gold-medal match against Thailand at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Gymnasium on September 25, 2026.

 Yong Teck Lim / Getty

 Samedy Sim of Cambodia competes during the men’s shot-put final on day seven of the 2026 Asian Games on September 26, 2026.

 Katsura Tanioka / Getty

 Dharmveer Choudhary of India starts the men’s 4x400-meter relay at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium on September 29, 2026.

 Yong Teck Lim / Getty

 Kirill Prokhodov of Kazakhstan celebrates after defeating Hyomin Jang of South Korea to win gold in the fencing men’s epee team finals on day eight of the 2026 Asian Games on September 27, 2026, in Tokoname, Aichi.
